title: ge bench-all result
description: The JSON file written by `ge bench-all --out NAME` (NAME.json). Rates are tokens per second; memory is in GB (1e9 bytes).

model.description: Model file name and size, e.g. "Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf (4.92 GB)".

cpu.description: CPU model, SIMD level used, physical core count and usable RAM.

gpus.description: Vulkan GPUs found, with total VRAM, or "none (no Vulkan)".

os.description: Operating system and architecture, e.g. "windows x86_64".

workload.description: Human-readable summary of the settings below.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt length for the prefill measurement (--pp).

gen_tokens.description: Tokens generated for the decode measurement (--tg).

context.description: Context length the session was sized for (--ctx).

placement.description: Where the layers ran, e.g. "CPU", "GPU 36/36 layers", "hybrid 22/32 on GPU". Empty when the configuration failed.

decode_tok_s.description: Median decode rate (plain greedy generation, no speculative decoding).

peak_ram_gb.description: Peak process working set, including mapped model pages.

vram_gb.description: GPU weights plus session buffers; null for CPU-only.

error.description: Why the configuration could not run, e.g. "does not fit: needs 4.62 GB of VRAM, 3.53 GB free".
